errors.text: The proposed Mg-Al-Cr-Ni system replaces the target ball-milled MgAlTiVFeCo BCC solid solution, so its assumed phase pathway is not a reconstruction of the relevant material.
The intervention omits SPS at 1000 °C and instead proposes a two-stage hot-press cycle ending at 920 °C, directly contradicting the target optimum.
Dynamic recrystallization is invoked during ordinary hot pressing without the severe deformation or high strain rate required by the cited friction-processing evidence.
FCC-L12 formation is extrapolated from AlCoCrFeNi-based alloys aged at substantially different temperatures and is not established for the proposed Mg-rich alloy.
The proposed experiment excludes a 1000 °C specimen and therefore cannot test whether 920 °C outperforms the actual upper-window optimum.
Corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl, passive-film polarization behavior, and chloride penetration resistance are not tested.
